description: USE THIS when someone asks "what changed", "has anything changed", "anything new", "new closures since" or "new fire restrictions since" for the camps of a plan or trip, at up to three camps since a date (at most 30 days back). If the person names only a forest, first call find_camps for up to three camps in it (use their record ids), then call this and say which camps were checked. It returns only what is new, dated and sourced: National Weather Service alerts issued on or after the date (quoted as written, with the issue time and link), a change in the season window the camp record holds between the date and today, and whether the camp data on davelalande.com was rebuilt after the date. It does NOT read the forest's posted fire orders, campfire restrictions or closure orders, so it cannot say whether those changed; say so, and send the person to the forest office (or posted_orders where that tool is listed). Also lists what was checked and found nothing new, what is not watched (wildfire reports carry no dates, so they are not watched for change), and any read that failed ("could not read; not the same as none"). "Nothing new in what we watch" is not the same as nothing changed. It never says a camp, road or route can be used. Answers include `say` (two sentences to speak) and `tiny` (under 160 characters for a satellite text).

camps.description: One to three camps: record ids from find_camps (best) or camp names.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the date the plan was made or last checked. At most 30 days back, not in the future.
